household.name: scoop; bailer
household.title: scoop; bailer
household.reason: A wooden canoe bailer/scoop attributed to the Tillamook, a Pacific Northwest coastal people for whom canoe equipment is a typical traditional household item.

household.name: basket
household.title: basket
household.reason: A twined cedar-bark and grass basket, a classic Northwest Coast household item consistent with Tillamook craft traditions.

jewelry.name: necklace
jewelry.title: necklace
jewelry.reason: A dentalium shell, glass, and brass bead necklace, a classic Pacific Northwest Coast trade-era adornment type consistent with Tillamook use and attributed to them by the museum. Dentalium shell necklaces were widely made and worn by Tillamook and neighboring groups.
